notes.text: The Install button no longer shows once an app is installed: bbl-install.js adds isStandalone() and detectInstalled(), which asks the browser whether the app is already on the device.
Anything marked hidden now stays hidden even when it has a button style (it showed the Install button after installing).
Light theme: the Fixed and Improved labels and success text are darker, for 4.5:1 contrast on their pill backgrounds.

title: First release of the Bench Boss Labs kit

notes.text: Brand colours, type and spacing in light and dark themes, from the Bench Boss Labs design system (bbl-tokens.css).
Shared components: app header, buttons, cards, fields, pills, chips, update banner, toasts, dialogs and the What's new list (bbl-components.css).
Update banner, What's new and App history, read from each app's release-notes.json (bbl-updates.js).
The standard Install section for Settings › This device: installed, an Install button, or the steps for this device (bbl-install.js).
Opens with no internet, with a 4-second fallback to the saved copy; a rink Wi-Fi sign-in page can't break it (bbl-sw.js, bbl-offline.js).
On-device storage with schema versions, automatic upgrades with a backup first, and Backup and Restore files (bbl-store.js).
The stamp script writes the version into every file and builds CHANGELOG.md (scripts/stamp.mjs).
